thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — PD-INC-8721 — autoscaler_queue_backlog (prod) for service infer-frontend. queue_depth=4123 for 6m, consumer_lag > 90th pct. severity: P1. https://pagerduty.local/pd/PD-INC-8721 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PD Incident created and paging on-call. Escalation policy: inference-prod. Details attached.

Maria Chen: ack — I'm oncall rn, taking lead. pulling SLO dashboards and logs.

Aj Patel: ack — standing by to assist. on call for infra.

Samir Reddy: watching tail of consumer logs, seeing repeated backlog spikes and 502/504s from frontend.

Maria Chen: quick triage — autoscaler metrics look flat for last 10m despite queue_growth. Check shows controller failing to provision new nodes: provider API returns quotaExceeded and kube-apiserver throttling on scale requests (429). controller logs: `error creating instance: 403 QuotaExceeded` then `client: request failed with 429`.

Maria Chen: paste logs:
```
E 2024-06-10T17:12:03Z autoscaler-controller createNode request failed status 403 QuotaExceeded: request id=abc123
W 2024-06-10T17:13:01Z autoscaler-controller scaling decision delayed: retrying after backoff
E 2024-06-10T17:13:12Z autoscaler-controller api error: 429 Too Many Requests from kube-apiserver
```

Aj Patel: that matches the provider quota angle. which pool is affected? looks like infer-pool-us-east-1a max=120 current=120.

Maria Chen: confirmed. pool at capacity set by node-pool config. cloud console shows pending approval for quota increase (sent to cloud-quotas@).

ops-sre-bot: Notifying cloud-ops channel about quota request ID CQ-4452. ETA from provider ~45m.

Maria Chen: mitigation plan: 1) manually bump node pool limit (if we have permission) 2) enable emergency fallback routing to smaller model variant (redwood-small) for non-critical routes to reduce per-request runtime. 3) throttle new ingests via rate-limiter to slow backlog growth. 4) on-call to monitor queue drain.

Aj Patel: I can do manual node pool scale — running provider CLI now. command:
```
# increase max nodes for infer-pool-us-east-1a
cloudctl node-pools update infer-pool-us-east-1a --max-size 160 --requester=aj
```

Aj Patel: update — CLI returned OK but cloud returned "async operation started". provider console shows scaling operation in progress (launching 20 instances).

Samir Reddy: pushing a temporary rate-limit on public ingestion route to 60% of normal TPS. Doing a config flip now.

Maria Chen: applied temporary route throttle. traffic drop observed, queue growth reduced but still high. errors from frontend dropped from 12% -> 7%.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note — Escalated to L2 after 8m (policy escalation). New responders: Aj Patel, Samir Reddy.

Aj Patel: provider instances are in provisioning; some failed due to missing startup script (image pre-pull failure). I'm re-triggering instance group rolling update to use baked image.

Aj Patel: command run:
```
cloudctl ig rolling-update infer-ig-frontend --image=redwood-inference-runtime-20240608
```

Maria Chen: starting graceful dispatcher scale-down on long-running tasks to free up capacity. also enabling prefix KV cache read-only to reduce memory pressure.

Samir Reddy: checking consumer workers — we have a config flag to enable short-mode which reduces tokens-per-request and disables some post-processing. toggling it for 10m window.

Samir Reddy: command:
```
./adminctl set-config --service infer-frontend --short-mode true --duration 10m
```

Samir Reddy: short-mode enabled. latency decreased ~18%, token usage dropped ~22%. good temporary relief.

Maria Chen: metrics — queue depth now stable at ~2.4k and trending down. error rate ~3.5%. still monitoring.

pagerduty: PD Incident note: Acknowledged by Maria Chen and Aj Patel. Timeline being recorded.

Aj Patel: new nodes are online and joined cluster. autoscaler now has room to scale normally. controller logs show scale operations succeeding again.

Maria Chen: confirming: autoscaler reacted, additional replicas spun up, queue drain rate improved. Running post-fix sanity checks on infra and model correctness on redwood-small fallback.

Samir Reddy: verified inference outputs for short-mode + redwood-small — sanity ok for high-throughput flows, flagged a minor formatting regression in assistant messages (missing trailing newline) but not user-blocking.

Maria Chen: handing off to Aj for follow-up during off-hours. going to sleep in 15m. please keep PD incident open until 1h stable and then close.

Aj Patel: taking over. I'll keep monitoring for 1hr. next steps: 1) follow up with cloud-quotas to get formal quota increase 2) postmortem with action items 3) add autoscaler retry/backoff handling to detect provider 429s earlier and open tickets automatically.

ops-sre-bot: Created follow-up ticket INFRA-2022: request provider quota bump and add quota alarm in monitoring.

Maria Chen: quick customer-impact note for comms: "Transient increased latency and ~12% elevated error rate for infer-frontend customers between 17:12 and 17:34 UTC. Mitigated via rate-limiting, emergency node scale, and fallback to redwood-small. No data loss."

Aj Patel: updating PD incident with resolution steps and planned remediation.

incident-bot: PD-INC-8721 status changed to RESOLVED by Aj Patel at 1718000900 after stability window passed.

Samir Reddy: quick retrospective (thread): what allowed pool to hit hard cap? need to audit autoscaler headroom settings and add proactive quota-alarm to dev dashboards. also consider emergency pre-warm for known high-traffic windows.

Maria Chen: action items I/O — add to postmortem: a) add provider quota monitor b) raise default pool headroom to avoid hard cap c) improve health checks to fail fast on image pre-pull issues d) add automatic short-mode fallback when queue growth > threshold.

Aj Patel: noted. I'll draft runbook changes and link to postmortem.

Maria Chen: thx all :thumbsup: good run.

ops-sre-bot: Reaction :thumbsup: recorded from Samir Reddy.
